body: Part 3 (the question about download progress, D-52) is built in the pull request that adds app/lib/features/downloads/download_notifications_prompt.dart: built, not walked (a smoke test on an emulator, docs/evidence/c07-download-notification-ask.md). Parts 1, 2 and 4 (the server stage, the two stages and the reason for a wait, a failed song with Retry) are NOT built: they wait for their drawing, to be drawn together with the offline state P1-15. This item is therefore NOT marked built, and P0-13 still depends on it.
